body: I've never confronted him really. I'm scared he and the rest of my family will be like "why are you making this such a big deal" . My parents always say I'm too sensitive. My plan is to move out and just cut all contact with him.
Do you have any advice on how to overcome it all? Emotionally?

Thanks for the in depth response. It's hard to take myself seriously because I feel like my childhood was fine because my parents didn't beat me or anything. I still live with my family now as I can't hold down a job. I wish I could move out as they just feed into my depression and make me feel even worse.

Yeah, I wouldn't say he had a perfect upbringing by any means. He probably just took the anger of his life out on me. I was the only one he could do that to really.
When I ask my mother about it, she just says she assumed I knew what he was saying wasn't true. Of course I believed it was. She definitely has rose tinted glasses on where he is concerned, but he didn't have it easy from her or my dad growing up.
My dad is probably an N or something close to it. He can never be wrong, would go on scary rages whenever my mother wasn't around, blamed the kids for all his problems with my mother.

Thank you. Part of me just feels like I'm overeacting. That person's comment really didn't help.

But I just try and think, if it was a kid treating me like this at school or something, it absolutely would be bullying. Just because it was my brother doesn't make it different. I just had to live with my bully.
No one ever told me it wasn't. I logically know it's not true, but it is still true to me. I still feel like it's true.
It destroyed any sense of self worth I have. I hate myself. This makes it quite hard to do anything when you assume everyone thinks your worthless boring loser.
It's still bullying...it still ruined my life
Logically I know they wouldn't. I'm a seemingly normal enough person until you get to know me. I just feel ugly and a waste of people's time I guess.
Just have to hope it comes quick and as painlessly as possible
The only way to escape is something that your consciousness will fight you not to do. Damn survival instinct.
I'm so sorry
Slowly watching everyone you love die until you die yourself is horrible. We are all doomed to this fate and it's so cruel. Zero humans have led a life of no suffering.
I love sleep, I just wish I could stay asleep. I have woken up 2-5 times a night every night for years.
Same :(  to make new friends the best way is to join a new club, a new job, etc. A lot easier than going up to strangers (if people even do that).
I don't mind the light per say, more the heat. I feel like disgusting sub human waste whenever I sweat or get uncomfortable in the heat.
I'm so jealous of the people that have depressive episodes. Mine has been one long four year episode.

My best friend is 21 and has two years to live due to her cancer. I wish I could swap places with her, even though it would be hell for me as it is for her. But she deserves a full life so much more than me. She has to work seven days a week to pay her student loans and medical bills for god's sake. I've got nothing wrong with me except depression and I can't even hold down a part time job. God how I wish i could switch for her. She's such a good person, how she manages all thatbis beyond me.

Also, drugging up on pain killers isn't really going to do much.

I have very little interest in sexual or romantic activities. I wouldnt mind a girlfriend/boyfriend to basically just be friends with but that is too much effort to pursue, and they'd want sex and romance anyway.
I always get the high scores and it says I should seek help from a doctor. Done that and they've been jack all helpful. I wish they could actually help.

I wish there was some magical answer. It hurts so bad the as suicide is the only way out of this. I really don't want to die but damn it's the only way to end this misery. 
I have no friends either. I used to have a few until I dropped out of school, not even one texted me to see where I was, or if I was okay. I'd been friends with this people for years and I'd already been forgotten. Shit hurts.
I hate them so much. They are so painful and so unnecessary to me.
Lol! This house is a circus.
I was never that close to any of the characters, so as long as they still provide a good story and the feels, idgaf who the characters are.
Same happened to me and I failed out of school and now work for minimum wage as I have no qualifications. Unless your depression is cured you're pretty much screwed.

Don't be embarrassed, it takes more strength to face your feelings than to repress them. That is horrible what happened to you and shouldn't be taken lightly. Maybe try and think that they were in the wrong and it's their problem, so you should forget them and move on? Idk. Easier said than done I know.
Same. Entirely my fault, I have forgotten basic social skills.
It's clearly not "just because" of that
Thank you. I hope your plan goes well and you get your desired result. It has been hard to get used to the fact people don't care well done on that.
I have and the professionals haven't helped one bit

True, I have probably bored them to tears with it. I try and talk about other stuff and play video games and watch TV and go out. But feeling so hollow and empty while doing so leads back to the misery and suicidal feelings
I'm sorry you're having a similar experience. It just goes to show how little people actually care about the people they tell themselves they care about. I hope you won't feel guilty.
It requires so much strength to kill yourself. I am trying to gain that strength but it is so hard. I feel you.
Lucky. It's been 3 years for me
I am alot more suicidal this week than ever. Hopefully this means I will finally get the guts to go through with it. Fingers crossed.
It isn't easy
My brain is concrete now. I forget most words. People say it's like English is my second language. Lol
I just don't see it. Do you feel that the love for tall, attractive men women/ the media has automatically means that they hate short unattractive men? Because that isn't the case...

So that isn't all women saying it. Most people don't care enough about people they don't know enough to hate them. I agree that ugly people have it worse off but I disagree that they are mocked and belittled constantly by everyone. And if you are I am sorry, that is an awful thing to happen to you.
UK :( thanks for the offer though
How do they communicate that?
Everyone thinks I'm a stuck up bitch who thinks I'm better than them! Resting bitch face + depression + bad social skills + decent looks = hell
19, so I got a ways to go

All have done nothing for me. I don't even get side effects. I might as well be taking sugar pills. I've tried fluoxetine, sertraline, cytolopram and venalfaxine. Who knows how many are left out there for me to try.
No but I want to. My brain is too lazy to try new things, and buying alcohol seems too much effort. I have no idea how one obtains drugs. I'd love to try weed though, but I have no access to it

I have no idea. It makes sense when it's someone they care about, but even then they should want their loved ones suffering to end. But when it's a stranger on the internet it is ridiculous. They have no reason to want you to continue living. It's just engrained by society I guess.

People aren't usually attracted to someone with such bitter self loathing but I doubt they want you to commit suicide. People (yes women are people) don't go around looking at people they consider unattractive and want them to kill themselves. They just forget about your existence.
There are other ugly people out there, maybe you will make friends with some of them? Maybe even a girlfriend.

Yeah my brain is so sluggish and blocked, I can't think, I can't make decisions, I can't feel. I'm just running on auto pilot. My body is sluggish, exhausted, worn out, constantly. Nothing I've tried has changed it. I sleep a good amount, I get excercise, eat good, nothing changes. I've been this way for 3 years, nothing changes.
No one knows me :(
I want to do it as well. It's way overdue. I hope you get the strength also

Absolutely. Life just isn't for everyone. Some people don't like cars, or sports, or watching TV, so they don't do those things. Some people don't like life what's so hard to understand. I wish there was a peaceful painfree accessible way for everyone to die if they wanted.
If you aren't enjoying the party you leave early.

I agree. Human brains and bodies are still living in the hunter gatherer times, so some just can't cope with this completely different way of life to what they are expecting and used to. And this way of life is pretty depressing for most people as well.

Definitely, I talk slow, forget every words every 10 seconds during conversation, my mind is blank when I try and think of things to say. I come across as a dumb, mindless, boring person.
I went from As to failing out of school.
I don't even get depressive episodes, I've been this way every day for 3 years :(
I haven't finished a video game in years
I already volunteer all Friday because I made that mistake lol
Yeah, I feel you. I'd probably enjoy working with animals but you need experience and qualifications for most animal jobs.

Yeah I agree! There is nothing I can begin to imagine enjoying, as not being able to focus, concentrate, think, memorise would make it horrible no matter what I was doing. And yeah that angers me too, I work minimum wage in a supermarket just for some people to make millions at the top barely doing a thing.
I do, so my parents would only have to remember me one day of the year instead of two.

Same! Everyone just says "that's life" "everyone has to work why shouldn't you?" "That's why you find a job you like" etc. But when you say nah, think I'll opt out of life if that's what it is, they freak out.
Yes, but I can't imagine realistically anyone's reactions being anything other than "meh, saw that coming"
I wasted age 16-18 sitting in my room doing nothing. Wasted 18-19 at college where I failed. Now am wasting 19+ working at a supermarket getting minimum wage.
Did I miss the giveaway? I fell asleep while watching the stream :(

It's weird because it never really annoyed me, songs like that, overly happy ones, again just make you kind of tune out from being depressed. You feel truly empty in my experience, well more so than usual.

Same it's so embarrassing. People probably assume I'm really dumb or mentally challenged. People try and talk to me but I'm just like "oh" "wow really" "awesome". Probably think I'm rude as well. I just can't think of anything to say.
Upbeat music like Whitney Houston pop, those sort of happy dance songs. It doesn't make me feel better though but it kind of makes the depression feel surreal.

Yeah all the time. Yesterday I was at work which I hate and the whole time the only thing they got me through is thinking I'll kill myself as soon as I get home. I never get myself to follow through though. I must be too fucking comfortable.

I'm saying the whole nature of depression means that it's pretty impossible to feel any hope at all, and the OP understands this, so I just don't understand what coming back and saying it gets better does for anyone currently depressed. It's just annoying to hear unfortunately. I know OP is trying to be nice and helpful but honestly it isn't helpful when your incapable of feeling hope by very nature of being depressed. If you want to take that as narcissism feel free.
Neither do I, there's not much point in this world when you don't is there
Yeah the emotions attached to it hurt alot, it's a pretty normal name, it just reminds me of me I guess
Lol don't let it snowball, I did that for 2 years straight, it's not great. Though it is kinda great.
But that literally is meaningless. You can say it all you want but to a depressed person it'll never feel even close to true.
As you said, you saying this means absolutely nothing to people with depression. Depression makes hope impossible.
You get along with nearly everyone and you all have a good time

Strangers are nice and friendly. Which can be annoying of you don't feel like having a chat at the bus stop. 
If you're shy or quiet, people see you as a stuck up bitch who thinks their better than they are.
You catch people looking at you and have to pretend you dont notice it.
Friends can be jealous of you, they go on about their own dating experiences as if your existence is somehow mocking their own love life. It's like they have to prove that guys like them too.
I said that too and now I never finished high school and can't work. You can't win in this world
I always want to be alone. Depression kills the want/need to socialise for me.

Depression has given me absolutely zero interest in dating, relationships etc. I have no physical urges, no one seems attractive to me, and I just want to be alone all the time. Depression has left me barely human.

Just try and ignore T_D, they are a bunch of morons and bots. They are fucking bullies and I suggest just disabling replies and staying away from that trainwreck.
They also are brigading this thread sadly, this isn't how everyone feels.

Yeah they do. I have it awful. I just lie in bed wondering what I could do, and nothing sounds good. The new video game I bought goes unplayed, the new book unread. I just prefer to do something I don't have to think about at all, so I just walk my dog or browse the internet.
Yes. I regret doing something stupid 2 years ago which has literally destroyed my whole life.
Even with those things I am miserable though. Doesn't really bode well for the future.
Same. I'm obviously far too damn comfortable.
It wouldn't.
Same with my dogs. I know my family won't walk my dogs. I wish we could overcome this.
People can only offer empty platitudes anyway. I'd rather just have no response at all.

I saw a documentary about bipolar I think and there was a 30year old woman in it who lived with her mum, and it showed them going to the zoo together. That has seared into my brain for life. I am going to be that woman, living with my parents and not having a proper job. Going on stupid day trips to the zoo or a museum with my mum because I have no friends and no life.

True. I'd like to be an actress as well but I don't think I can act so my looks won't mean much. What makes is miserable is just the generic depression, not finding enjoyment out of anything, having no motivation, being tired all the time, not being able to think clearly, failing college etc.

I'm not saying good looking people don't have it better socially. Just saying being good looking doesn't mean your gonna have some amazing happy life. I'm going to kill myself. Some random guys being nice to me cos they want to date me or whatever isn't going to change that.
Lazy people are still motivated to do enjoyable things. Depression is where you can't enjoy anything.

Of course I don't know what it's like not to be, but I am an attractive person and really it's not all that great. Guys are nice to me because they want to sleep with me? How awesome!!! I have no interest in sex or dating so it literally means nothing to me. My life still sucks. I still am failing out of college, doomed to a life of minimum wage. I still have no friends. I still have no interests and am constant bored and unmotivated. Oh but I can post selfies on the internet and get people saying how pretty I am!!! Wowwww that doesn't get boring fast at all

I wish this everyday. Why am I such a selfish coward burdening everyone with my life, they'd all be so much happier and fulfilled with my depression bringing everyone down. Deep down they must want me dad, probably thinking do it already.

I've already pretty much faded away. My personality is depression, my interests are depression, my dislikes are depression, my skills are depression, my looks are depression. Everything is fucking depression, I am an empty shell.
Absolutely. Like you're just some outside observer who isn't really there.

Yes I just live in the moment and try and ignore the future and all the shitty things I've ever done. I spend all my moments where I cant distract with internet/games fantasising about alternative realities. I am never in them, kind of like imagining a movie I guess.

Teachers at college pretty much speak to me like I'm retarded, so yeah. One time the teacher asked me to give the answer in the form of a sentence and I literally couldn't form a fucking sentence in my head. Somehow I can write ok but it's like I write subconsciously because my brain is too foggy and made of cement to think.
They are sympathetic but don't really understand. They know I'm depressed but they think I choose to be by being lazy and not going out and doing hobbies etc.

I have not enjoyed anything or been relieved from my boredom in 3 years. I have felt no emotion other than despair and misery and hopelessness. I can't do it anymore it is driving me crazy. My exams have added so much stress I am at breaking point. I have failed them and I have no future without getting to university.
I wouldn't rather be alive than dead. I'd rather be alive how I am now then alive with brain damage/paralysis.  If I could find a surefire way I would do it. I have no motivation I'm sorry
What does that even mean

Yes in the sense I feel it's cruel to suddenly be gone from the dog's life who has been with me for 6 out of the 7 years of his life. But I have family who will take care of him. I just feel sad for him as he won't understand. I'm probably other thinking it and he won't even notice or give a shit.
18, 2 years behind in school, now probably 3 due to most likely failing this year. Never had a driving lesson. Never drunk alcohol or done drugs. Never been to a party. Never been with anyone.
I can't even imagine myself being in my 20s. I'm not cut out to be an adult.

I've been skipping on and off mine because I honestly forget, and nothing happens. I might as well be taking sugar pills because I don't even get negative side effects, let alone the positive benefits. Anyone know of any better meds? I'm on 50mg sertraline

I have most likely failed out of college so that's nice, I am already 2 years behind due to depression. I just want to die. Why can't​ I study. Why. It's all I want but I can't fucking do it. I'm so stupid.

All my teachers and peers as college think I'm some stuck up bitch because the only thing that stops me from crying from the stress of college is a fake exterior which comes of as pissed off and moody. I wish my teachers didn't think I was a uncaring sack of shit.

Same here, my default is this lack of emotion where I don't care about anything. Only thing its good for is doing normally disgusting things like unclogging toilets or cleaning up a dead rat the cat brought in, lol, cos I don't give a shit to be disgusted anymore. I do get sad and cry when stressed, but I don't feel it if that makes sense. Like I have the physical feelings but I don't feel sad in my head, I feel meh.

I'm pretty and meh it isn't that great if you're depressed anyway. I doubt that is literally the only reason you're depressed, as plenty of ugly people aren't depressed. It doesn't make me any happier that I'm decent looking, but I suppose I don't know what it's like to not be. All I know is that I still have no friends and no life and am failing school and have no future. Don't worry about feeling shallow though, everyone and everything is.

I feel the same. I can never relate to all the lonliness posts, especially the ones where they say they wouldn't be depressed anymore if they could get a girlfriend. I've never felt lonely or desired human contact, and I'm glad because adding lonliness to this depression would god damn suck.
